name: Roselind Dresner
source:
"She is the University's information clerk in the main hall, and the PA to Dean Gigi. She also studies there, but to earn extra money she accepted a receptionist and information clerk job. She's friendly and open to most people but never had a permanent boyfriend. She did however find a possible suitor in the University but haven't had the courage to approach him yet.
She's an only child and still lives with her mother and father. She enjoys reading and loves to visit her favorite secluded beach for some alone time."

[In-game description]
